english.title: Fail to leave Bristol Airport when requested to by constable / airport official
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) remained on Bristol Airport after having been requested to leave by a constable or an Airport Official,

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

having reasonable grounds to believe that you had committed or were about to commit a criminal offence or breach a byelaw
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4.26 and 3.4 of the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
